relationship: Aligning two scaled versions of a recurring decimal lets subtraction cancel the repeating tail and exposes its exact fractional value.

learnerLoop.action: Align the recurring rows, subtract them and follow the remainder cycle.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The displayed decimal equations and fraction calculation advance together.
learnerLoop.evidence: Aligned digits, cancellation, checked working and repeating remainders support the exact fraction.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose the required scale or subtraction step to isolate the original decimal.

invariants: Equivalent repeating tails cancel only after correct place-value alignment.
A repeated remainder produces the same subsequent digits.
safeAdaptations: Use different terminating or recurring digit patterns with exact fractional results.
Vary working support while preserving the alignment-and-subtraction argument.
nonGoals: Replacing the exact conversion with decimal rounding.
